prompt: What is the purpose of the quarterly wear figures?
promptZh: 季度磨耗數據的用途是什麼？

options.text: To show how many molds the workshop borrowed.
options.zh: 顯示工坊借了幾具模具。
options.whyZh: 借用紀錄保留在登記表，不是磨耗數據要顯示的內容。

options.text: To show how quickly the workshop’s own molds wear out.
options.zh: 顯示工坊自有的模具磨損得多快。
options.whyZh: 首段直接說明：季度數據用來看自有模具磨損的速度。

options.text: To show how long it takes to renew a mold’s surface.
options.zh: 顯示重整模具表面需要多久。
options.whyZh: 正文提到一次重整延遲，但磨耗數據不衡量重整時間。

options.text: To record how many production runs each workshop completes.
options.zh: 記錄各工坊完成了多少次生產作業。
options.whyZh: 生產讀數是量測來源；磨耗數據本身不統計生產次數。

explanationZh: 首段直接說明：季度數據用來看自有模具磨損的速度。
evidence: The quarterly wear figures are meant to show how quickly our own molds wear out

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The quarterly wear figures are meant to show how quickly our own molds wear out

vocabulary.note: leave an item out of a total 表示不把它計入。
